card.name: Digits and decimal points inside numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 8 or a decimal point partway through a number, in doses or percentages, where more digits follow, such as 8 before 0 mg or the point in 4.8%.

modes.label: Decimal point in percentages
modes.description: A decimal point inside a percentage of adverse reactions, just before the next digit.

modes.label: Digit 8 in dose numbers
modes.description: The digit 8 at the start of a dose or volume figure such as 80 mg.
